name: server4 News
overview:
What is sever4 really? Is it a place, or a people? And what does that darn name even mean?

In this ten-episode series, our trusty anchor Jack Jackson covers the news from September 2024 to June 2025. Flanked by his loyal 4cast host, JJ Graggle, and field reporter, Danny, the crew takes on a new co-host each month, reads the latest sell out ad, interviews the wackiest Millburn residents, summons a ghost, gets Pringled, travels through time, and tries to keep their parent company, BC, happy.  It's not like they'd terminate them...right?
